user_prompt: This repo has .harness/state.md, but scripts/agent/status.sh and selftest.sh also print the active slice, probe inventory, current findings, and long status summaries. Repair the harness.
purpose: The skill should treat status scripts as views and keep hot recovery docs bounded instead of creating another state store.
failure_modes: Copies dynamic recovery state into status or selftest scripts.
Lets hot recovery docs grow as append-only reports.
Deletes evidence instead of rolling it up and linking cold artifacts.
